svg.font-family: Schibsted Grotesk, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Optical and magnetic tweezers
svg.desc: Top: a DNA molecule held between two optically trapped beads while an RNA polymerase transcribes it. Bottom left: magnetic tweezers pulling and twisting a DNA molecule carrying nucleosomes. Bottom right: field of view with many tethered magnetic beads.
